svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: TCP handshake, close, reset, timeout

g.text: Three-way handshake: SYN, SYN/ACK, ACK synchronize both sequence spaces.
Orderly close: each side sends FIN and acknowledges the peer's FIN.
Closed port 8081: the server answers RST immediately — refused, not timed out.
Filtered port: iptables DROP silently discards SYNs; retries end in a curl timeout.
